text:
ellie: Mini game: one song + one short story that you'd happily fall asleep to while still paying attention. I'll go first: 'Night Moves' (ambient cover) + 'The Yellow Wallpaper' by Charlotte Perkins Gilman. Creepy but dreamy.
raj: Nice. Mine: 'Porcelain' (Moby) + 'Auspicious' (very short experimental piece) nah jk, actually 'A Clean, Well-Lighted Place' by Hemingway. quiet & hollow. :coffee:
noah: Love it. my pick: 'Holocene' (Bon Iver) + 'Interpreter of Maladies' by Jhumpa Lahiri (title story). gentle & human.
tess: quick one: 'Asleep' (The Smiths) + 'St. Lucy's Home for Girls Raised by Wolves' by Karen Russell. odd lullaby. :wolf:
meme-bot: Reminder: reading in bed may trigger 2am existential thoughts. :sweat_smile:
ellie: Haha agreed. If you like someone else's, drop a "+1" and which pair.
raj: +1 @noah (Holocene + Interpreter)
oah: thanks @raj. final thoughts: I might swap in an instrumental piano for Holocene sometimes.
tess: +1 @ellie (Night Moves + Yellow Wallpaper) because vibes.
ellie: tally: @ellie 1, @noah 1, @tess 1. thanks for playing! maybe next time: one movie + one song? :popcorn:
